issues.detail: SI headings assign conflicting stereodescriptors: C17 is called 2S in 25-28 despite the unchanged source drawing from R-24; The 29 heading also disagrees at C9 and C17; 30 agrees with the drawing-derived assignments. Drawing-derived graphs are authoritative here; independent review is required.
Main/SI scheme reports E/Z 8:2 but SI prose names isolated E material. Encode drawn E with explicit mixture qualification; do not claim stereopure material.
SI prose and scheme differ for multiple reaction times (16a,16,17,10,22,25,26,28,29/30); no standardized trusted time assigned.
